ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (>95% distribution) with high-intensity (white) outliers localized at fluke tips and scattered across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark charcoal base across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white contiguous patches are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white focal spots (mottling) are distributed across the mid-to-lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch vertex is clearly defined and symmetrical.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Higher amplitude 'peaks' and 'valleys' are concentrated on the lateral thirds of each lobe, while the medial edges near the notch are relatively smoother.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve characterized by an initial convex sweep from the medial notch, transitioning to a sharp concave trajectory near the distal tips, creating pointed upward-curving terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of white circular pixel groups are visible at the distal tips of both lobes. Individual circular white spots are scattered across the interior regions of both lobes, particularly on the right side.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. A prominent diagonal white scratch is located on the upper-left lobe. Several smaller, roughly horizontal linear marks are visible on the mid-to-lower region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and focal depigmentation/scarring across the majority of the visible ventral fluke surface.
